controls.name: My Ad Center (Personalized Ads)
controls.description: Disable personalized ads across Google Search, YouTube, Maps, and millions of partner websites.
controls.impact: Stops ad targeting based on search queries and watch history.

controls.name: Location History / Timeline
controls.description: Pause automatic tracking of places visited and routes traveled with mobile devices.

controls.name: Web & App Activity + Voice Recordings
controls.description: Stop saving audio recordings from Google Assistant and search app browsing history.
controls.impact: Halts human audio review and transcription storage.

controls.name: Third-Party App Access
controls.description: Revoke permissions from apps and games that have access to your Google account and Gmail.
controls.impact: Eliminates backdoor data leaks from inactive apps.

controls.name: Off-Facebook Activity Disconnection
controls.description: Disconnect external website visits and app activities transmitted to Meta via Meta Pixel.
controls.action: Click 'Disconnect specific activity' or 'Clear previous activity'

controls.name: Ad Settings & Partner Data Matching
controls.description: Block advertisers from targeting you using your uploaded customer lists (phone number/email).
controls.action: Set 'Data about your activity from partners' to NOT ALLOWED
controls.impact: Stops CRM matching from e-commerce checkouts.

controls.name: Facial & Biometric Recognition Settings
controls.description: Verify biometric recognition tagging and automatic photo suggestions are disabled.

controls.name: Interest-Based Ads Preferences
controls.description: Opt out of behavioral ad profiling across Amazon storefronts and affiliated ad networks.
controls.action: Select 'Do not personalize ads from Amazon'
controls.impact: Stops ads based on recent shopping browsing.

controls.name: Alexa Voice Privacy & Recording Retention
controls.description: Configure auto-deletion of voice recordings and disable manual human review.
controls.action: Disable 'Help improve Alexa' and enable auto-delete
controls.impact: Prevents retention of home microphone clips.

controls.name: Microsoft Privacy Dashboard
controls.description: View and clear Windows diagnostic telemetry, Cortana logs, and Bing search queries.
controls.action: Clear browsing and search history, set diagnostic data to 'Required only'

controls.name: Personalized Ad Opt-Out
controls.description: Disable personalized ad targeting associated with your Microsoft account across Edge and Windows.
controls.action: Toggle 'See ads that interest you' OFF

controls.name: Grok AI Data Sharing & Training
controls.description: Opt out of having your posts, replies, and account interactions used to train Grok and xAI models.
controls.action: Uncheck 'Allow your posts as well as your interactions with Grok to be used for training'
controls.impact: Protects public contributions from uncompensated AI training.

controls.name: Off-Twitter Data & Personalization
controls.description: Prevent X from tracking which websites you visit that have embedded tweets or pixels.
controls.action: Turn off 'Personalize based on your inferred identity'

controls.name: Apple Data & Privacy Portal
controls.description: Download a complete copy of Apple ID data, correct info, or request complete Apple ID deletion.
controls.action: Sign in to inspect stored records or request erasure
controls.impact: Direct exercise of right to access and deletion.

controls.name: Personalized Ads in App Store
controls.description: Turn off first-party personalized ad targeting across App Store, Apple News, and Stocks.
controls.action: On iOS: Settings > Privacy & Security > Apple Advertising > Turn OFF
controls.impact: Prevents profile creation inside App Store.
